description: For every budget line, the budgeted amount equals the spent amount plus the remaining amount. All 52 budget lines satisfy this relation.

scope: Distinguishing budget-level spending from item-level expenses
description: The budget spent amount is a category-level figure that equals the sum of the individual expense amounts linked to the same budget line. A total amount spent for a budget category uses the budget spent amount; an expense on a date or the cost of a described purchase uses the individual expense amount.

scope: Disambiguating the reused field number fld023
description: The field number fld023 occurs in two tables with different meanings: budgeted amount in tab05 and amount received in tab07. Resolve it by table context; income questions use the income amount in tab07.
Event status values are Open, Planning, and Closed. A closed event has status Closed.

scope: Classifying or filtering events by type
description: Event types are Meeting, Guest Speaker, Game, Social, Community Service, Election, Budget, and Registration. A game event has type Game.
Income source values are Dues, Fundraising, School Appropration (as stored), and Sponsorship. A fundraising record carries the literal source Fundraising.

scope: Interpreting who counts as a member
description: Position values are Member, Inactive, President, Secretary, Treasurer, and Vice President. General references to members can include officer positions; an explicit filter on ordinary members uses the value Member.

scope: Constructing or matching a member name
description: A member full name is the first name, one space, and the last name. Full names are unique across the 33 member records.

scope: Interpreting date values and extracting years
description: Event date-time values are ISO-8601 strings with a time component (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS); expense and income dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Calendar year is the first four characters of a date value.

The department field holds department, school, or program names, including values beginning with School of; the college field holds college names beginning with College of. A value beginning with School of is a department value, not a college value.

Three event names occur more than once (Football game, Community Theater, and Laugh Out Loud); an event name alone does not always identify one event. Use the date or event identifier to disambiguate.
One member record has no major value. Analyses that list all members must retain members without a major.
Attendance is recorded as a row linking a member and an event. The absence of a row means there is no recorded attendance; it does not establish that the person was absent.

Expense descriptions are free-text comma-separated item lists. Similar descriptions such as Water, Veggie tray, supplies and Water, Cookies identify different expenses; match the complete description when a question names specific items.

scope: Coverage of budget and event data
description: Budget lines exist for 23 of the 42 events. All recorded budget spending belongs to events dated 2019; the 2020 event-budget total is zero.
